The Digital Humanities unit at the University of Bern maintains a shared **Zotero group library** with literature on digital methods, theory, teaching and the disciplines that use them. It grows with our courses and projects and is open to everyone: the collection below is read live from the group, so it always shows the current state.

Browse the bibliography by its collections – open a collection to see its subcollections and entries, and open an entry for its details – or search across all entries.

## How to contribute

Members of the University of Bern can **join the group** on [zotero.org](https://www.zotero.org/groups/2386895/dh_unibe/) and add literature themselves; please file new entries in the matching collection and use the existing tags. For questions, write to [digitalhumanities\@unibe.ch](mailto:digitalhumanities@unibe.ch).
